sentences: Randomized SAT algorithms may miss a satisfying assignment while never incorrectly declaring an unsatisfiable formula satisfiable.
The question asks to rule out algorithms with that one-sided error using both quasilinear time and logarithmic space.
The source emphasizes that reversing the permitted error direction changes what lower-bound methods can prove.
Deterministic time-space tradeoffs do not automatically handle random choices.
The project seeks a lower bound matching the error behavior of incomplete randomized search procedures under extremely small resource budgets.
